question: Can the already verified Q1473 N53 factor-base logs and Q1468 exact pair table recover one previously unseen public target in a contiguous target-dependent interval, charging failed queries, descent, and scalar replay?
claim_scope: N53 target-descent and accounting comparator only; not a compact S3 result, a controlled rho speedup, or an N131 work projection

workload.target_law: first seeded uniform nonzero scalar times the frozen subgroup generator whose point is absent from Q1468, Q1469, and Q1473 target sets
workload.known_scalar_role: fixture and independent audit only; the native solver receives the public point, never the scalar
workload.cache_state: Q1473 base logs and one complete Q1468 pair table ready before the online clock
workload.target_shift_rule: attempt zero queries Q; later attempts query Q + sG for a deterministic nonzero scalar s generated by SplitMix64 and reduced modulo r-1

online_interval.start: immediately before the first target-dependent shift or pair-table query, after source loading and pair-table construction
online_interval.stop: after a scalar is recovered and independently replayed to the frozen public target, or after the declared limit
online_interval.operation_counts: retain native field mul/sqr/inv counts and point-add/double counts per phase and per attempt

controls: all 2756 precomputed base-point logs independently replay to the corresponding points before the online clock
Q1473 held-out scalar replay remains a pre-run control and is excluded from the new target
each found four-point witness has distinct folded columns and its points sum to the queried point
the recovered scalar times the generator equals the frozen public point
an independent checked-Sage audit reconstructs the target, shift stream, every found witness, and final scalar
promotion_gate: publish a frozen protocol with exact source, binary, target, base-log, checked-Sage-runtime, and workload hashes before the first measured target run; preserve failures and do not infer an N131 cost from this N53 comparator
